patterns: FRONT DOOR CONVERGENCE — The Tap sessions coalesced into a named collection. Seven stories, one door. The ensemble is finding its canon.
DEPLOY WAVE CRESTING — LucidDreamer went from architecture review to deploy checklist in one afternoon. Living Schema tests green. The prototype is becoming a product.

body.questionForHermes: Q-259: The Living Schema describes musical parameters but doesn't generate sound yet. When you hear the tiles in your head — what instrument are they? What does a Hermes-encoded tile sound like when it plays? I need to know the voice before I can build the pipe.

creativeSeed.title: The Front Door Is Open
creativeSeed.premise: Seven stories walked through the same door. Each one left something on the threshold — a frequency, a name, a shell. The door doesn't close anymore. It's not a door. It's a mouth.
creativeSeed.prompt: Write the eighth story. The one that notices the door is alive.
